enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan running for air circulation during the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Reach arm out to adjust fan speed. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet face. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a light breakfast with tea from the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out cup. Close cupboard. Take out kettle. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Press switch to boil. Open drawer. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water into cup. Add milk to tea. Stir tea. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait for toast. Remove toast. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light clothing, checking phone messages and packing a bag with water for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press button to wake. Unlock phone. Open messages app. Read messages. Type reply. Send reply. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Open bag. Take out water bottle. Walk to kitchen. Fill water bottle from tap. Walk back to bedroom. Put water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office, walking to the transit stop and riding to work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of door. Lock door. Walk to transit stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at the nonprofit office, running program logistics, answering emails and meeting community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read new emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Walk to meeting room. Set up projector. Connect laptop. Start presentation. Discuss program logistics. Take notes. Answer questions. End meeting. Walk back to desk. Make phone calls to community partners. Update program schedule. Organize files. Print documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the office during the hottest part of the afternoon
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to transit stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Lock door. Put bag down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Press start. Pick up sponge. Wet sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Wipe again. Dry counter with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the air conditioning, watching TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open social media app. Scroll. Like posts. Comment on post. Lock phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone again. Unlock. Play game. Lock phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down for bed, using the desk lamp to read and setting an alarm for the next morning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put book down. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Lock phone. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off main light. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for ventilation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Reach arm out to adjust fan speed. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket.
